```{=html}
<div class="mirror-comparison">
  <div class="mirror-world current-world">
    <strong>Our world</strong>
    <div class="mirror-vectors">
      <span class="spin-vector">\(\mathbf I\)</span>
      <span class="electron-dot">\(e^-\)</span>
      <span class="momentum-vector left">\(\mathbf p_e\)</span>
    </div>
    <p>The electrons are emitted predominantly opposite to the nuclear spin.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="mirror-plane" aria-label="mirror"></div>

  <div class="mirror-world reflected-world">
    <strong>Mirror world</strong>
    <div class="mirror-vectors">
      <span class="spin-vector">\(\mathbf I\)</span>
      <span class="electron-dot">\(e^-\)</span>
      <span class="momentum-vector right">\(\mathbf p_e\)</span>
    </div>
    <p>The mirrored process predicts the opposite asymmetry.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```
